purpose: Bound current-f01e AutoRound TP2/MTP4/eager/F16 at exact 4K only. The completed TP2/MTP3 scoped campaign is the hard mechanism parent, while the completed TP2/MTP0 4K receipt is the sole target oracle. Require exact depth and cache zero, isolated finite positive conserved acceptance, exact 128-token target parity, full objective and same-topology baseline quality, TP2 topology, rank-cache isolation, and cleanup. No automatic depth expansion, publication, or descendant is authorized.

parent_oracle.gate: The scoped parent must remain a clean five-depth 4K-32K TP2/MTP3 result with exact parity, positive conserved acceptance, full objective and TP2/MTP0-baseline quality, TP2 worker topology, rank-cache isolation, and cleanup. Its 4K depth and verification receipts are separately hash-pinned. This parent authorizes only this preregistered sentinel.

target_oracle.gate: The candidate must return exactly the same 128 token IDs as this same-image, same-topology TP2/MTP0/eager/F16 4K receipt. TP1, TP4, MTP1, MTP2, and MTP3 outputs are not targets.

historical_risk.tp1_mtp4: The current-f01e TP1/MTP4 8K sentinel passed, but a separate-boot expansion diverged from TP1/MTP0 first at token 99 and later killed EngineCore at exact 32K on the speculative-token shape assertion. That blocks treating one pass as long-context authority.
historical_risk.tp4_mtp4: The current-f01e TP4/MTP4 exact-8K sentinel drafted 124 tokens and accepted 97, passed objective/baseline quality and cleanup, but diverged from TP4/MTP0 first at token 99 and is structurally quarantined.

tp2_mtp4_8k_quarantine.gate: This existing same-profile exact-8K failure remains a speedless structural quarantine. A clean 4K observation cannot clear, replace, or reinterpret it.

historical_risk.sentinel_only_reason: The same TP2/MTP4 profile is already target-divergent at exact 8K, and MTP4 has topology-local parity and long-context risk on neighboring topologies. A single exact-4K sentinel is the smallest clean-parent measurement; 16K/24K/32K remain unauthorized even if 4K passes.

speculator_binding.type: native embedded Qwen MTP; no external draft model

exact_depth_contract.gate: Exact active prompt depth 4096, cached_tokens == 0, 128 returned token IDs, and every helper exact-depth check passes.

acceptance_contract.snapshot_scope: Both speculative counters immediately before and after only the exact-4K request, with no intervening traffic.
acceptance_contract.gate: All before/after/delta values finite; counters nondecreasing; drafted_delta > 0; accepted_delta > 0; accepted_delta <= drafted_delta.

quality_contract.gate: pass_all, baseline_match_all, seven exact cases, eight deterministic repeats, long context, and all 16 usage records explicitly cached_tokens == 0.

terminal_classification.passed-quality-clean-sentinel: Exact depth/cache-zero, exact target parity, isolated positive conserved acceptance, objective/baseline quality, TP2 topology, rank-cache isolation, and cleanup pass.
terminal_classification.quarantined-target-parity-failed: Exact depth and acceptance pass but any output ID differs from TP2/MTP0; preserve lower-grade evidence without publication or descendant authority.
terminal_classification.quarantined-acceptance-failed: Exact depth passes but isolated speculative counters fail.
terminal_classification.quarantined-quality-failed: Mechanism gates pass but objective, cache-zero, or baseline quality fails.
terminal_classification.quarantined-exact-depth-failed: The exact 4K or cache-zero gate fails.
terminal_classification.unsupported: Only an explicit exact-image native-MTP unsupported line qualifies.
terminal_classification.failed: Startup, binding, topology, identity, metrics, rank-cache, cleanup, or harness failure.
